written.myAnswer: Permanent magnets are used in D.C. motors and generators, moving-coil loudspeakers, door catches and refrigerator/freezer door strips, to remove iron objects from grains in flourmills and iron splinters from eyes, and to reset the pointer of a maximum-and-minimum thermometer. Electromagnets are used in electric bells and electric cranes.

Yes. In an A.C. generator, a coil is rotated between the poles of a permanent magnet. This changes the magnetic field through the coil and induces an emf. When the coil is connected to an external circuit, an alternating current flows.
